payload.description_html:
Middle cervical vertebra of “Tanystropheus ” antiquus Huene (now referred to its own genus Protanystropheus) from the Lower Muschelkalk (Anisian, Middle Triassic) of Winterswijk, the Netherlands, no. A 638 Oosterink collection.

Top: Photograph. Bottom: outline drawing.

Explanation: Di = diapophysis; G.psz. = postzygapophyseal groove; Nk = neural canal; Pa = parapophysis; Prz = prezygapophysis; P.sp = Processus spinosus (neural spine); Psz = postzygapophysis; Vk = ventral keel.
